_comment: Top-precedence icon overrides for ingredients, recipes, AND catalog (core items). Keys are ids (asset/prefab filename without extension). Value is a sprite name (must exist in the game bundles) or null to force-skip. Use this for: custom items you add, correcting a wrong curated match, or suppressing an icon. Takes precedence over ingredient-icons.json / recipe-icons.json / catalog-icons.json / auto <base>_Icon lookup. Example: { "ingredients": {"MyCustomIngredientSO": "Tomato_Icon"}, "recipes": {"Cake_Honey_SO": "ui_CakePlain_01"}, "catalog": {"Barbeque": "Campfire"} }
